[EN] Those poor soldiers died so horribly. I only hope their sacrifice wasn't in vain.

The Staff of Isren's a relic worth fighting for. I just hope it's enough to turn the tide!
[ES] Esos pobres soldados murieron de forma horrible. Solo espero que su sacrificio no haya sido en vano.

¡El Staff of Isren es una reliquia por la que vale la pena luchar! ¡Solo espero que sea suficiente para cambiar las tornas!
